name: DataTable
description: A feature-rich data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and row selection

props.data: T[] - array of data objects with unique id
props.columns: Column<T>[] - column definitions with key, header, render, sortable
props.onSelectionChange: (selected: T[]) => void - callback when selection changes
props.emptyMessage: string - message when no data (default: 'No data available')

usage_examples: <DataTable data={users} columns={[{ key: 'name', header: 'Name' }, { key: 'email', header: 'Email' }, { key: 'role', header: 'Role' }]} selectable onSelectionChange={setSelectedUsers} />

<DataTable data={orders} columns={[{ key: 'id', header: 'Order ID' }, { key: 'total', header: 'Total', render: r => `$${r.total}` }, { key: 'status', header: 'Status', render: r => <Badge variant={r.status} /> }]} pageSize={20} />

design_tokens.header: bg-white/5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider
